summary.text: Sheila Lyman is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 76 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A teacher by background, she has served in the Maine House since 2020.

paragraphs.text: Sheila Lyman lives in Livermore Falls, Maine, and graduated from Leavitt Area High School in 1978.
She earned a B.S. from the University of Maine at Farmington in 1982, and her career experience includes working as a teacher.
Lyman first won a seat in the Maine House in 2020, when she defeated incumbent Christina Riley in District 74, and she won District 76 in 2022 and 2024.
She served on the Education and Cultural Affairs Committee in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024, and was ranking member of the House Engrossed Bills Committee in 2023-2024.
